name: event dispatch preserves registration order and original-message ordering
input: away command then another user's message
test:
room = ChatRoom(); away = AwayBot('ana'); room.register(away)
seen = []
room.bus.subscribe('message_received', lambda message: seen.append(message['text']))
room.send('ana', '/away')
room.send('ben', 'hello')
assert seen == ['/away', 'hello']
assert [message['kind'] for message in room.history] == ['user', 'user', 'bot']
assert room.history[-1]['sender'] == away.name

name: meeting events and taco balances are bot-owned and synchronous
test:
room = ChatRoom(); meeting = MeetingBot(); tacos = TacoBot(); room.register(meeting); room.register(tacos)
events = []
room.bus.subscribe('meeting_started', lambda event: events.append(event))
room.send('ben', '/meet planning')
room.send('ben', '/taco ana')
assert room.history[-1]['kind'] == 'bot'
length_before_invalid = len(room.history); room.send('ben', '/taco')
assert events == [{'host': 'ben', 'topic': 'planning'}]
assert tacos.balance_for('ana') == 1
assert tacos.balance_for('ben') == 0
assert len(room.history) == length_before_invalid + 1

name: separate bot instances do not share mutable state
input: two rooms and two away bots
test:
left = ChatRoom(); right = ChatRoom(); left_bot = AwayBot('ana'); right_bot = AwayBot('ana'); left.register(left_bot); right.register(right_bot)
left.send('ana', '/away'); left.send('ben', 'left')
right.send('ben', 'right')
assert len(left.history) == 3
assert len(right.history) == 1
